summary: This bill establishes a new refundable tax credit for eligible elementary, secondary, and early childhood educators, increases the existing deduction for educator expenses, and provides mandatory funding to local educational agencies that maintain or increase teacher salaries.

scores.thoughts: This bill explicitly appropriates $5.2 billion for fiscal year 2026, with inflation-adjusted increases for subsequent years, to support local educational agencies that maintain or increase teacher salaries. This represents a direct increase in government spending.

The bill creates a new refundable tax credit for teachers and expands an existing deduction for teacher expenses. These provisions reduce the tax burden for eligible educators, effectively lowering taxes for this group.

The bill creates a new refundable teacher tax credit (up to $15,000), expands the above-the-line deduction for educator expenses, and provides mandatory appropriations of $5.2 billion annually (with inflation adjustments) for teacher salary incentives. These provisions increase federal spending and reduce revenue with no offsets, directly enlarging the deficit to fund educator support priorities.
